authored_native_control.scope: Exact original six Go source modules in isolated minimal module; authored public-API caller; no network/services

findings: CoverageScore(empty,nonempty) returns0, identical to perfectly covered nonempty input. Lower-is-better metric therefore cannot distinguish total omission without separate cardinality/validity state. Native positive and omission controls confirm.

MMR with NaN Lambda and TargetK1 returns empty result for two valid chunks without error; normal Lambda1 selects high-score chunk. Constructor clamps only values comparing below0/above1, so NaN survives.
SelectTopK returns unsorted input order when len(representatives)<=k, despite returns-topK-by-score comment; atK2 low first, atK1 high first. NegativeK panics at slicing.
RerankWithQuery overwrites caller slice Score fields even when result selects subset. Native caller-mutation control confirms; no existing immutability contract assumed.
MMR equal-score candidates traverse map iteration order and allocate n-by-n similarity matrix. Tie determinism/resource bounds not qualified by current controls.
transfer_decision: Do not treat empty coverage as proven success; validate nonfinite policies and requested counts, and make ordering/mutation contracts explicit. No foreign production implementation copied.
limits: Authored public controls only, no original upstream suite/full dependencies.
